title: Move-Out Terms of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement by Unit Class
content:
The move-out terms of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement depend on its unit class for the notice period, the credit for unused days and the cleaning fee; the deposit and credit-balance release periods are the same in every class.

| Unit class | Notice before the planned vacate date | Unused days of the final period credited | Cleaning fee | Fee for a lock left on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 0 calendar days | no | $75.00 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 0 calendar days | no | $50.00 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 0 calendar days | no | $50.00 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 0 calendar days | no | $50.00 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 10 calendar days | yes | $75.00 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 30 calendar days | yes | $95.00 | $25.00 |

## Release periods common to all six classes

| Release | Period after the vacate date |
|---|---|
| Security deposit balance released | 30 calendar days |
| Credit balance refunded | 21 calendar days |

## Definitions

- **Notice before the planned vacate date** — calendar days of notice required between the move-out notice date and the planned vacate date.
- **Unused days credited** — whether the unused days of the final paid billing period are credited at move-out.
- **Cleaning fee** — charged when the facility walk-through finds debris or belongings left in the vacated unit.
- **Fee for a lock left on** — charged when the tenant lock is left on a unit the tenant reports as vacated.

## Points of reading

- A tenant of a Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Interior Standard, Climate Controlled or Climate Plus unit may give notice for a vacate date on the notice date itself, since the notice period is 0 days.
- In the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault the planned vacate date is at least 30 calendar days after the notice date, and unused days of the final charged period are credited.
- The cleaning fee is $75.00 in the Bluegate Drive-Up Standard and Bluegate Premier Climate Suite classes and $95.00 in the Vault.
